{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Create a mask for valid baseline biomarker values
valid_baseline = df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0

# Filter the data to exclude rows with sentinel values
df_valid = df[valid_baseline]

# Check the size of the filtered dataset
print("Original size:", len(df))
print("Filtered size (valid baseline):", len(df_valid))

# Check if the arms are balanced in the filtered data
print("\nArm distribution in filtered data:\n", df_valid['arm'].value_counts())

# Check if severity is balanced across arms in filtered data
print("\nSeverity distribution by arm in filtered data:\n", pd.crosstab(df_valid['arm'], df_valid['severity']))

# Check if sex is balanced across arms in filtered data
print("\nSex distribution by arm in filtered data:\n", pd.crosstab(df_valid['arm'], df_valid['sex']))"}
